title: AI apps and machine learning · Level 3
slo: Identify the parts that make an application an AI application.

exercises.question_text: Which statements describe a model-powered AI application? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: A model-powered application uses a trained model. The model supplies learned processing.
The trained model processes input. That processing leads to useful outputs.

options.text: It can produce text, images, or decisions
options.rationale: Model-powered applications can produce these outputs. Their trained models help produce them.

options.error_type: Confuses model-powered app with static program
options.rationale: A static program follows only fixed rules. A model-powered app uses a trained model.
options.better_fit: Use this for traditional preset-rule software.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Model-powered apps use trained models to process inputs and produce outputs.

exercises.question_text: Which description best fits an AI application?

options.rationale: An AI application is software that uses AI techniques. It performs intelligent tasks for users.

options.text: A broad capability for human-like tasks
options.rationale: This describes AI as a broad capability. The application is software that uses that capability.
options.better_fit: Use this for artificial intelligence itself.

options.text: A mathematical system trained on data
options.rationale: This describes an ML model. A model can be an engine within an application.
options.better_fit: Use this for a trained ML model.

options.text: A service that only stores data
options.rationale: Storage retains data but does not perform an intelligent task. An AI application processes input using AI techniques.
options.better_fit: Use this for a data-storage service.

exercises.explanation: Correct. An AI application is software that uses intelligent techniques.

exercises.question_text: Order the pieces to form the correct statement.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The technique and its speech-to-text function would not connect clearly.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Name the technique first, then its conversion action and result.

exercises.correct_answer: Speech AI converts spoken words into text
exercises.explanation: Speech AI converts spoken words into text, distinguishing it from vision and extraction.

exercises.question_text: An AI application that uses trained models to process input and produce outputs is ___.

parts.text: An AI application that uses trained models to process input and produce outputs is

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: You would name improvement or a process instead of the app property.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Use model-powered for an app based on trained models.

exercises.explanation: Model-powered identifies an application that uses trained models.

exercises.question_text: Put the pieces in the correct order.

feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Start with the application, then what it uses, then its purpose.

exercises.correct_answer: An AI application uses AI techniques to perform human-like intelligent tasks
exercises.explanation: The sentence starts with the application, then states its method and purpose.

exercises.question_text: A customer-service manager needs an app to pull key phrases from customer emails, not analyze images or transcribe calls. Which approach should the manager choose?

options.rationale: Information extraction identifies useful information in content. Key phrases in emails are useful written-content details.
Computer vision analyzes images and visual material. The manager needs phrases from written emails.
options.better_fit: Use this when analyzing images or other visual material.

feedback.intrinsic: The manager would not receive the needed email phrases.
feedback.instructional: Use information extraction for useful details in written content.

options.error_type: Confuses email analysis with speech processing
options.rationale: Speech AI converts between speech and text. The task begins with written emails and needs their key details.
options.better_fit: Use this for spoken language or speech-text conversion.

feedback.intrinsic: The manager would get speech processing instead of email insights.
feedback.instructional: Choose information extraction for useful email content.

options.error_type: Confuses technique with industry use case
options.rationale: A recommendation engine suggests products. It does not retrieve phrases from emails.
options.better_fit: Use this in retail to suggest products to shoppers.

feedback.intrinsic: The manager would get product suggestions instead of key phrases.
feedback.instructional: Information extraction retrieves useful content details.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Information extraction is the best fit for email key phrases.

exercises.question_text: An education system that adapts feedback to each learner's pace is an intelligent ___.

parts.text: An education system that adapts feedback to each learner's pace is an intelligent

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: The learner would receive a label for a different domain.

exercises.explanation: An intelligent tutoring system adapts feedback to a student's pace and learning style.

exercises.question_text: What can a machine learning model do? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Models are trained to recognize patterns in data. Those patterns support later outputs.
A trained model can make predictions. It uses learned patterns to do so.
A model can generate outputs such as text or decisions. Generation is a possible model result.
Fine-tuning is a process used to improve a model. It is not an output produced during ordinary model use.
options.better_fit: Use this for updating a model after initial training.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Models find patterns and make predictions or outputs.

options.rationale: AI is designed for tasks that normally require human intelligence. These include reasoning, perception, and language understanding.

options.error_type: Confuses AI with an AI application
options.rationale: This describes an AI application, which is software using AI. AI itself is the broader capability.
options.better_fit: Use this description for an AI application.

options.error_type: Confuses AI with an ML model
options.rationale: This describes a machine learning model trained on data. A model is narrower than AI.
options.better_fit: Use this for a trained ML model.

options.text: A static set of program rules
options.rationale: Fixed rules describe traditional static software. They do not define AI's human-like capabilities.
options.better_fit: Use this for a preset-rule program.

exercises.explanation: Correct. AI is the broad capability for tasks that normally need human intelligence.

exercises.question_text: Inference is when a model is retrained using new data.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: You would confuse using a model with changing it.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: Retraining changes a model; inference uses it on new input.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Inference applies a trained model to new input.

exercises.question_text: A hospital imaging manager needs a tool to help doctors review X-rays and MRIs. Which choices fit this goal? Select all that apply.

options.rationale: Healthcare AI can analyze X-rays and MRIs. This directly supports medical-image review.
Medical-image analysis can help doctors detect diseases. This is a relevant healthcare outcome.
AI-assisted image analysis can help doctors review scans more efficiently. This can support faster diagnosis.

options.error_type: Confuses healthcare with finance fraud detection
options.rationale: Transaction flagging belongs to financial fraud detection. It does not help doctors review medical scans.
options.better_fit: Use this in finance to identify suspicious transactions.

feedback.intrinsic: Doctors would receive bank alerts instead of scan support.
feedback.instructional: Match X-ray and MRI review with healthcare image analysis.

exercises.explanation: Correct. Medical-image analysis supports scan review and disease detection.

exercises.question_text: Artificial intelligence is limited to following fixed rules and cannot support reasoning or perception.

feedback_for_incorrect.intrinsic: You would treat AI as only a fixed-rule program.
feedback_for_incorrect.instructional: AI is designed for tasks that normally need human intelligence, including reasoning and perception.

exercises.explanation: Correct. AI can support tasks such as reasoning and perception.
